permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Listens to the conversation while a session is running so it can be transcribed and short suggestions can be shown. Audio is streamed to the speech provider you chose and never stored.

permissions.name: phone-microphone
permissions.desc: Optional alternative to the glasses microphone, selectable in settings. Audio is streamed to the speech provider you chose and never stored.

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Sends audio and transcript text only to the speech and AI providers you selected, using your own API keys. No other servers, no analytics.
